deepDiveBlocks.heading: Private Clinical Assessment
paragraphs: Private pharmacy services provide faster access where clinically appropriate, with fees and treatment options explained before you commit.
A qualified pharmacist assesses suitability, discusses expected outcomes realistically, and signposts to GP care when symptoms need investigation beyond pharmacy scope.

preparationGuide: Insurance or employer details if applicable
timelineNotes: Book early for services needing lead time
comparisonPoints: Private services are typically self-pay unless employer-funded
NHS pathways may cover related care for eligible patients — we explain options at consultation
Assessment is required before treatment — instant supply without review is not offered
